newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 4.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - First meeting of French and Ivorian business and industry leaders to take place in Abidjan on November 5-6, under patronage of Ivory Coast President Henri Konan Bedie, newspaper advertisment says. LA VOIE - Chief opposition leader Laurent Gbagbo of Ivorian Popular Front party, in major political address, challenges President Bedie to come up with "minimum" government programme and. LE JOUR - About 60 French entreprises to be represented at talks with Ivorian partners, principally on business environment in Ivory Coast; meeting takes place on eve of 10-day Ivory Coast Trade Fair starting on Thursday with several foreign firms expected to exhibit. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
